name: technical
description: Documentation, specs, API references, runbooks, README files.
register: impersonal, instructional, optimised for scanning not reading
notes: The register that most needs its own thresholds, and the clearest proof the
profile system is not decorative. A reference doc SHOULD be rhythmically
uniform: consistent sentence shapes are what make it skimmable. Judging it
against essay thresholds flags the thing that is working.
Corporate-register vocabulary is also legitimate here in a way it is not in
marketing copy — 'robust' is a precise term about failure behaviour, and
'comprehensive' is a factual claim about coverage. See allow.txt.
